meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 它会把任务拆成一步步极小的动作,开工前先按 references/define-goal.md 登记目标,并把每个原子步骤同步到实时计划清单。每个成功标准都要有来自真实环境(终端、HTTP、浏览器等)的可观察证据,长任务支持检查点续跑。
howto.when: 当你提到 ulw-loop、ulw 等关键词,或要求可断点续跑的长任务时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 跑这个任务,先登记目标再开工
把这一步的证据记进 ledger
say.note: 证据绑定当前 git 树,树变了要重跑重记

say.text: 看一下当前 ulw-loop 会话的状态

howto.what_en: Claude breaks work into ultra-granular steps, registers goals up front, mirrors each step into a live plan checklist, and needs observable evidence from a real surface per success criterion. Long runs resume from checkpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop or ulw, durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Run this task with ulw-loop: register the goal first, then start.
say_en.note: Goals are shaped before any implementation.

say_en.text: Record this step's evidence in the ledger.
say_en.note: Evidence is bound to the current git tree.

say_en.text: Show the current ulw-loop session status.
